item.title: Trees need cutting down and causing damage, 26th September
item.description:
The trees considerably hang over the boarder of my property at 24 Anerley grove. The trees are too tall for me to prune myself. The trees block all light into the back yard. In addition the roots are also causing damage to my property fences and walls and I have genuine concerns about cracks appearing with my property on the sides the roots are approaching the property. I recently had significant works done to clear all of my drains as the roots had completely punchered, damaged and blocked all the drains. I have added a snapshot of the report in the pictures. The trees are not only hanging over the boundary of my property but also causing long lasting and costly damage. I’d appreciate reviewing what can be done with this trees above simply pruning back to prevent any further damage of my property Thank you, Bethan

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 24, Anerley Grove, Crystal Palace, Greater London
